title: USB-C Dock/Hub with Ethernet
body:
Even ChatGPT is struggling to help me with this and I've been researching for a few days now with no luck. I'm looking for a dock/hub that connects to my laptop via USB-C, it needs to have at minimum:
4x USB-A Data (not just charge)
1x USB-C Data
1x Gigabit Ethernet
I could get away with only 3x USB-A data IF the USB-C Data has at least 2cm of clearance on each side.
My ideal price range is around $50 but if absolutely necessary I can go up to $100 max.
